# tissue_mast_person (Data Source)

A member of the account, looked up by email. Rotations, overrides and policy steps take the `user_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tissue_mast_person" "ana" {
  email = "ana@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The member's email. Case doesn't matter.

### Read-Only

- `phones` (Number) How many phones Mast pages for them.
- `role` (String) `owner`, `admin` or `developer`.
- `user_id` (String) The member's user id.
